models.description: speridlabs/idol: single-image reconstruction to a 3D Gaussian splat (.ply), with background removal and predicted camera metadata. One publisher checkpoint combines the denoiser, octree decoder, Gaussian decoder and BiRefNet; these components are not separate quantization choices. The gated DINOv3 encoder and FLUX.2 VAE are external dependencies, not included in this download. OpenCore has no integrated or verified IDOL generation adapter.

sources.runtimeReason: Requires the publisher IDOL SDK, Python 3.10+, PyTorch 2.5+ and compatible image/3D dependencies; the publisher documents NVIDIA CUDA execution. Access to the gated DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 encoder and FLUX.2-dev VAE is also required and their weights are not included here. The OpenCore IDOL image-to-3D Gaussian pipeline is not integrated or inference-verified.

models.label: Vortecks LFM3 1.7B Heretic Abliterated
models.description: Exact Vortecks Heretic-abliterated edition with all 25 published GGUF files, from experimental low-bit formats to BF16, F16 and F32. The pinned LFM3 engine prepares automatically; actual text generation must pass after installation. Published 256K context metadata is a capacity, not a long-context quality test.

models.label: mondk LFM3 1.7B Claude Code
models.description: Exact mondk tool-use and coding fine-tune, published as one Q8_0 GGUF. It is a local LFM3 derivative, not an Anthropic model or hosted Claude service. Uses the pinned LFM3 engine with verification after installation; publisher benchmark results are not OpenCore tests.

models.label: LFM3 1.7B LiteRT
models.description: Exact LiteRT-LM conversion with two weight precisions, INT8 and mixed INT4/INT8, each published with a 2048- or 4096-token cache. Each bundle embeds its tokenizer and modified chat template. These are .litertlm packages, requiring a real Android LiteRT-LM adapter; they cannot load in llama.cpp. No NPU package is published.

sources.runtimeReason: Requires a real Android LiteRT-LM 0.18.1-compatible adapter with a separate Engine per conversation and the bundled template/state handling. OpenCore has no integrated verified LiteRT-LM runner. This .litertlm package cannot load in llama.cpp; context is limited to its published 2048 or 4096 tokens.

models.label: Guilherme34 LFM3 Looped HiddenCoT
models.description: Exact research edition with structural changes and a latent-token thinking prefix, published as Q6_K and Q8_0 GGUF. Includes the publisher-required external chat_template, which differs from the embedded GGUF template. Its reported behavior and quality remain unverified in OpenCore.

sources.runtimeReason: Requires the LFM3 runtime plus explicit selection of the pinned external chat_template and its latent-token prefix. The current OpenCore runner uses the embedded template and has no external-template selection hook; correct Looped HiddenCoT inference is not yet verified.

models.label: mohommed LFM3 Frontier SmartAgent v4
models.description: Exact Frontier SmartAgent v4 SDT/SimPO edition with all three published Q4_K_M, Q4_K_S and Q8_0 GGUFs. Uses the pinned LFM3 engine and verifies actual generation after installation. The files declare 524288-token context; the publisher extension and quality claims have not been independently evaluated by OpenCore.

models.label: Kaitchup LFM3 1.7B SLQ
models.description: Exact EAR97.7 SLQ checkpoint: one mixed-precision GGUF with Q6_K as its dominant-family label, not an ordinary uniform Q6_K quant. The publisher EAR value measures calibration probability overlap, not benchmark accuracy or statistical equivalence. Uses the pinned LFM3 engine; generation is checked after installation.

models.label: orcarouter LFM3 1.7B Abliterated
models.description: Exact gated orcarouter abliterated checkpoint. Public publisher metadata identifies one BF16 safetensors model and the Lfm3ForCausalLM custom-code architecture. Publisher access is required for the files; no GGUF or additional quantization is published in this repository. OpenCore does not automatically execute repository code.

sources.runtimeReason: This publisher checkpoint is gated and declares custom Lfm3 Python code. Approved Hugging Face access and a separately reviewed compatible LFM3 Transformers adapter are required; OpenCore does not execute repository code automatically. No actual generation has been verified.

models.label: AtomicChat LFM3 1.7B Uncensored
models.description: Exact AtomicChat safety-ablated edition with both published AD-Q4_K_M and AD-Q6_K GGUFs. The ablation is baked into these weights, keeping this edition distinct from the base model and other publishers. Uses the pinned LFM3 engine; publisher quality claims are not OpenCore runtime tests.

models.label: Morphy 1.1 Coder Beta 7B
models.description: Publisher beta coding model. The exact repository currently publishes one Q8_0 GGUF. Its GGUF metadata reports a 32,768-token context; the publisher Modelfile defaults to 8,192. Runtime preparation and real generation must pass after installation.

models.label: TwIL-8B
models.description: Granite-based reasoning model in balanced and verbose editions. Non-commercial publisher license applies. Runtime compatibility and a real generation must be verified after installation.

models.label: Alpie Seed 9B
models.description: 169Pi AI's Qwen3.5-9B vision-language model for reasoning, coding and multilingual conversations. Includes the original BF16 checkpoint and all three publisher GGUF quants (Q2_K, Q3_K_M, Q4_K_M), each with the matching vision projector. Native context is 262,144 tokens subject to device memory; ECHO uses a 32K working window. Text generation is verified after installation; image and video understanding have not been verified in OpenCore.

models.label: Herculis CUA GUI Actioner 4B
models.description: Publisher Qwen2.5-VL screenshot and GUI-action model. Includes the original BF16 checkpoint and verified publisher/community GGUF quantizations with their vision projector. Text generation uses the managed runtime; screenshot grounding and autonomous computer operation have not been verified in OpenCore. Publisher-specific license applies.

models.label: Gliese CUA Tool Call 8B
models.description: Publisher Qwen2.5-VL model with separately labeled tool-calling and Localization editions. Includes their original BF16 checkpoints, published GGUFs and verified community quants; each GGUF retains its matching vision projector. The managed text runtime verifies generation after installation. Screenshot actions and autonomous execution remain unverified; compressed-tensors FP8 requires a separate adapter.

sources.runtimeReason: This publisher edition uses compressed-tensors W8A8 FP8 and needs a compatible quantized Qwen2.5-VL adapter. The managed BF16 Transformers runtime cannot load it. Choose a GGUF or original BF16 package for the integrated text runtime; FP8 generation has not been verified.

models.label: NorthCUA Nano
models.description: Beipo AI's Qwen3.5-based vision-language model for screenshot grounding and computer interaction. Includes the original BF16 checkpoint and twelve verified GGUF quants with the matching vision projector. Native context is up to 262,144 tokens subject to device memory. Preparation checks generation. Autonomous desktop actions have not been verified in OpenCore.

sources.runtimeReason: This community edition uses compressed-tensors NVFP4A16 and needs a compatible quantized Qwen3.5-VL runtime. Choose a GGUF or the original BF16 checkpoint for OpenCore's managed runtime.

models.label: LFM3 Coder Claude Distill 1.7B
models.description: LFM3-1.7B coding and reasoning finetune. Includes the publisher Q4_K_M and FP16 checkpoint plus all twelve verified mradermacher GGUF quants. Native context follows the published 262K limit; ECHO uses a 32K working window. Local quality and action execution must be verified on the installed runtime.

models.label: GUI-Swift 4B
models.description: Publisher desktop GUI action adapter for GUI-Owl-1.5-4B-Instruct. Predicts one action with 131 fixed slots in a single forward pass. Requires the matching base, codebook and publisher prediction runtime. This package is an action-prediction adapter; chat generation and autonomous desktop execution are unverified.

sources.runtimeReason: The 131-slot GUI-Swift inference path requires its publisher decoder and matching GUI-Owl base. The ordinary text-generation LoRA loader cannot execute this protocol.

models.label: GUI-Swift Mobile 2B
models.description: Publisher Android GUI action LoRA for GUI-Owl-1.5-2B-Instruct. Predicts structured mobile actions with 105 masked slots in one forward pass. Requires the matching base and publisher fixed-slot decoder. This checkpoint does not by itself provide an Android device-control harness.

sources.runtimeReason: The 105-slot mobile prediction protocol requires the publisher decoder and exact GUI-Owl base. A standard autoregressive LoRA runtime is insufficient.

models.label: MobileGym 4B
models.description: Qwen3-VL-4B mobile GUI agent checkpoint trained with reinforcement learning. Includes both complete model shards, tokenizer, chat template and image/video processor configuration. Native context follows the published 262K configuration; ECHO uses 32K. Screenshot prediction and Android action execution require a compatible vision and device harness.

models.label: KORMo GUI 4B
models.description: Korean/English Qwen3.5-4B vision-language web agent. The publisher serves it with a 128K limit and its own system prompt, 21 tool definitions and chat template. Access approval and a Hugging Face token are required. Text runtime preparation is separate from verified screenshot reasoning and browser action execution.

models.label: Edge0 145B
models.description: Official Edge0 145B latent-MoE coding model. Each precision downloads its complete expert, attention, per-layer embedding, tokenizer and MTP bundle with the default Q8 dense projections. Requires edge0-strata through edge0-infer on NVIDIA CUDA 13; publisher minimum is 16 GiB VRAM and 20 GiB system RAM. Memory and speed claims are publisher measurements, not OpenCore results. Edge0 Community Model License 1.0.

sources.runtimeReason: Requires the publisher edge0-strata engine through edge0-infer on Windows/Linux with NVIDIA CUDA 13, at least 16 GiB VRAM and 20 GiB system RAM. This complete latent-MoE bundle cannot load in the ordinary llama.cpp engine. An OpenCore managed Edge0 adapter is not integrated; inference is unverified.

models.label: Raon 1 nano
models.description: KRAFTON Korean/English text and tool-calling model with 1.5B effective parameters and per-layer embeddings. Official GGUF F16, Q4_K_M, Q6_K and Q8_0 editions have separate full MTP-inclusive checkpoints; MTP execution is unverified. Transformers, MLX GPTQ 4-bit and the fixed 4096-token LiteRT-LM bundle remain separate publisher packages. Nano requires its own reviewed runtime, not the older Raon mini engine.

sources.runtimeReason: Requires the publisher Raon1Nano Transformers implementation and reviewed custom model code. OpenCore does not execute remote Python code automatically; this architecture has no managed Nano adapter yet.

Official Apple Silicon MLX GPTQ 4-bit checkpoint with an 8-bit MTP module and publisher model code. No OpenCore Windows MLX/Nano adapter is integrated; this is not a BF16 export or a generic GGUF file.

Official LiteRT-LM bundle with 4-bit weights, FP16 activations and a fixed 4096-token context; it answers without thinking. Requires a compatible LiteRT-LM runtime, which OpenCore does not integrate. Cannot load in llama.cpp.

models.label: Baphomet-1.1-4B
models.description: CloudGoat's Qwen3.5-4B vision-language merge with evolved task-vector weights. Includes the original BF16 checkpoint and 12 GGUF editions converted by mradermacher from this exact model. GGUF downloads include a vision projector. The publisher declares a 262,144-token context; the loaded working window depends on the selected mode and available memory. Actual text and image generation are checked after installation.

models.label: deskpaw-CUA-2B
models.description: llstar's fully fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-2B GUI-grounding model. Given a screenshot and an instruction, its custom pointer head predicts a target click location in one forward pass. The six-shard BF16 checkpoint uses an isolated, managed pointer runtime. Predictions return screen coordinates; execution is a separate action under the current computer-use permissions.

sources.runtimeReason: Uses the publisher's reviewed custom pointer head through OpenCore's coordinate-prediction worker. Plain Qwen3-VL chat generation does not preserve this head. A real screenshot prediction must pass before the model becomes ready.

models.label: Haru-4B
models.description: higurashi-ai's multilingual full-duplex spoken-dialogue research model. It consumes microphone audio and produces speech and text together at 7.5 frames per second (24 kHz audio). The single BF16 checkpoint includes the language backbone, audio codec and speech head. Supports nine published languages and requires a reference voice recording; no voice clips are included. The publisher suggests an NVIDIA GPU with about 12 GB memory. Haru is a pretrained conversation model, not an instruction-tuned tool agent.

sources.runtimeReason: Uses the pinned publisher Haru duplex engine through a dedicated streaming-call adapter for simultaneous 24 kHz audio input, audio output and text frames. Real model audio frames must pass verification before calls become available. Haru does not use the plain Transformers chat protocol.

models.label: Budget3D-Idol
models.description: BudgetAny's IDOL fine-tune generates 3D Gaussian splats (.ply) from an image. One denoiser checkpoint supports adaptive token budgets from 0.0625 to 1.0; changing that budget reuses the same weights. IDOL's image encoders and Gaussian decoders, DINOv3 and the FLUX.2 VAE are separate requirements and are not included in this download.

sources.runtimeReason: Requires the Budget3D sampling engine, IDOL's shared image encoders and Gaussian decoders, the DINOv3 encoder and FLUX.2 VAE. The 1.512 GB download is the fine-tuned denoiser checkpoint, not all pipeline dependencies. OpenCore has no integrated Budget3D generation adapter; image-to-3D execution is unverified.

models.label: SenseNova-Loop-9B
models.description: SenseNova's full November 17 release, with 9B stored parameters, two shared decoder passes and two-stream mHC routing. Accepts text and images and generates text; supports the publisher's native tool-call format. Includes all 11 BF16/FP32 weight shards, tokenizer and processors. The model has a published 512K context; actual working context and speed depend on available RAM and VRAM. Hugging Face access approval is required. This is the full release, separate from Preview.

models.label: Inkling 2 Mini
models.description: Thinking Machines’ 26.4B-parameter looped mixture-of-experts model for text and images. Choose from 18 GGUF editions with a vision projector, the original NVFP4/MXFP8 release, or seven distinct Apple Silicon MLX editions. The model publishes a 1,048,576-token context. The managed Windows runtimes start with up to 32,768 tokens, depending on available memory.

sources.runtimeReason: Thinking Machines’ original mixed-precision checkpoint requires the publisher-supported vLLM or SGLang setup and compatible hardware. Windows chat uses one of the GGUF editions.
